name: Sypher Cookie Consent
author: Sypher

sections.description:
Sypher Cookie Consent makes it easy to integrate a professional cookie consent banner with your WordPress site.

This plugin helps your organization comply with the EU ePrivacy Directive and GDPR. It ensures cookies are placed lawfully and user consent is properly captured across devices.

Features

  • Google Consent Mode v2 compliant
  • Smart Cookie Scanner
  • Predefined Cookie Templates
  • Flexible Banner Layouts
  • Automatic Script Blocking

The Sypher Cookie Consent for WordPress makes integration with the Sypher Cookie Consent Manager as simple as activating the plugin and providing your website UUID key.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “sypher”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Adjust the settings on the Sypher Cookie Consent Settings page

Alternatively, you can install the plugin manually:

  1. Upload the sypher-cookie-consent directory to the wp-content/plugins directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Adjust the settings on the Sypher Cookie Consent Settings page
sections.changelog:
2026.1.0

  • Updated WordPress compatibility versions
  • Faster page loading: the banner styles no longer block the page from rendering
  • Improved compatibility with caching and optimization plugins (WP Rocket, Autoptimize, LiteSpeed Cache, SiteGround Optimizer, W3 Total Cache and Jetpack Boost): the consent scripts are no longer combined, minified, deferred or delayed, so the cookie consent banner works properly
  • The consent scripts now load before other scripts on the page
  • New option (in the “Performance” section of the settings page, off by default) to load the consent scripts with defer, for websites where every script that needs consent starts later
  • Improved compatibility with sites using a Content Security Policy
  • The website UUID is now validated when saving the settings, and an error message is shown if it is invalid
  • New PixelYourSite integration (optional, in the “Integrations” section of the settings page): PixelYourSite pixels and tracking cookies wait for the visitor’s consent in the Sypher banner, and start or stop as soon as the visitor changes their choice
  • A notice suggests enabling the PixelYourSite integration when PixelYourSite is active
  • Fixed a PHP notice on a fresh installation
  • Fixed minor issues on the settings page

2025.1.1

  • Updated description and tags
  • Updated installation instructions with automatic installation method

2025.1.0

  • Updated WordPress compatibility versions
  • Added new screenshots

2023.1.0

  • Updated WordPress compatibility versions
  • Updated links to sign up for Sypher Cookie Consent

2021.1.0

  • Initial release.
